filer_name.rationale: Filer name is a header-level field not represented as a leaf element in IRS5471ScheduleC; it belongs to the parent form header.

filer_identifying_number.rationale: Identifying number is a header-level field not represented as a leaf element in IRS5471ScheduleC; it belongs to the parent form header.

tax_year_begin.rationale: Annual accounting period begin date is a header-level field not represented as a leaf element in IRS5471ScheduleC.

tax_year_end.rationale: Annual accounting period end date is a header-level field not represented as a leaf element in IRS5471ScheduleC.

schedule_c_functional_currency.rationale: Functional currency code is a header/metadata field with no matching leaf element in the candidate list.

schedule_c_exchange_rate.rationale: Exchange rate is a header/metadata field with no matching leaf element in the candidate list.

gross_receipts_sales.rationale: ForeignGrossReceiptsOrSalesAmt maps to Schedule C line 1a gross receipts or sales in functional currency.

returns_and_allowances.rationale: ForeignReturnsAndAllowancesAmt maps to Schedule C line 1b returns and allowances.

net_receipts_sales.rationale: ForeignNetGrossReceiptsAmt maps to Schedule C line 1c net receipts or sales (1a minus 1b).

cost_of_goods_sold.rationale: ForeignCostOfGoodsSoldAmt maps to Schedule C line 2 cost of goods sold.

gross_profit.rationale: ForeignGrossProfitAmt maps to Schedule C line 3 gross profit.

dividends.rationale: ForeignDividendsAmt maps to Schedule C line 4 dividends received.

interest_income.rationale: ForeignInterestIncomeAmt maps to Schedule C line 5 interest income.

gross_rents_royalties.rationale: FrgnGrRoyaltiesAndLcnsFeesAmt best matches Schedule C line 6 gross rents, royalties, and license fees; ForeignGrossRentsAmt and ForeignRentsAmt are also related but this element name most closely matches the combined line 6 description.

net_gain_loss_on_sales.rationale: FrgnNetGainOrLossSaleCapAstAmt maps to Schedule C line 7 net gain or loss on sale of capital assets.

other_income.rationale: ForeignOtherIncomeAmt maps to Schedule C line 8 other income.

total_income.rationale: ForeignTotalIncomeAmt maps to Schedule C line 9 total income.

compensation_of_officers.rationale: ForeignCompensationNotDedAmt maps to Schedule C line 10 compensation not deducted elsewhere.

rents_royalties_paid.rationale: FrgnRoyaltiesAndLcnsFeesAmt maps to Schedule C line 11 rents, royalties, and license fees paid.

interest_paid.rationale: ForeignInterestDeductionAmt maps to Schedule C line 12 interest paid or accrued.

depreciation_depletion_amortization.rationale: ForeignDepreciationNotDedAmt is the closest match for Schedule C line 13; ForeignDepletionAmt (idx 4) is a separate element, indicating the schema splits depreciation and depletion while the blueprint bundles them — blueprint should be split into separate fields for depreciation and depletion.

taxes_paid.rationale: ForeignTaxesAmt maps to Schedule C line 14 taxes paid or accrued.

other_deductions.rationale: ForeignOtherDeductionsAmt maps to Schedule C line 15 other deductions.

total_deductions.rationale: ForeignTotalDeductionsAmt maps to Schedule C line 16 total deductions.

net_income_before_tax.rationale: FrgnTotalIncomeMinusTotDedAmt maps to Schedule C line 17 net income before income taxes (total income minus total deductions).

income_tax_expense.rationale: FrgnCurrentIncomeTaxExpenseAmt is the best single match for Schedule C line 18; however the schema also has FrgnDefrdIncomeTaxExpenseAmt (idx 23), indicating the schema splits current vs deferred income tax while the blueprint bundles them — blueprint should be split into current and deferred income tax expense fields.

current_year_net_income.rationale: ForeignCYNetIncomePerBooksAmt maps to Schedule C line 19 current year net income or loss after income taxes.
